meta.name: WordCrawler mock deck v1.1
meta.purpose: Content fine-tune before app build — 8–11 word limit on defVi and leadVi
meta.notes: defVi and leadVi must each be 8–11 Vietnamese words. Page 6 (anticipate) is a pure-Vietnamese tease before the English reveal. Never include English words, slang, or the target word.
meta.leadNote: Word-count constraint added: defVi 8–11 words, leadVi 8–11 words, anticipateVi 3–8 words.
